svg.title: Dried fig preservation methods stack
svg.desc: Editorial schematic of sun-drying, sulfuring, and packing stages for export; not a food-safety manual
svg.text: Dried fig preservation - schematic process stack

g.text: 1. Orchard pick - ripe syconia sorted by Brix / split risk (regional practice)
2. Sun trays / awnings - Estahban, Aydin, California Central Valley climates
3. Optional sulfuring (SO2) - color retention debate; label laws vary by market
4. Pressing / layering - lye-dipped Smyrna vs natural-dark Mission styles
5. Export pack - wooden cases, later cartons; rail to port to re-drying at destination

svg.text: Schematic - not to scale - figure ID shared.preservation-stack-pass2
